# Draft:Template:IIHF Men's World Ranking leaders

This graph shows the time periods each national men's ice hockey team has been at the top of the IIHF Men's World Ranking.
ImageSize = width:200 height:1400
PlotArea = left:40 right:0 bottom:10 top:10
# Just short of the date the next version of the IIHF World Ranking will be released (dd/mm/yyyy). Rankings update the day after the next IIHF or IOC Competition
Define $enddate = 31/05/2026
DateFormat = dd/mm/yyyy
Period = from:29/09/2003 till:$enddate
TimeAxis = orientation:vertical format:yyyy
ScaleMajor = unit:year increment:1 start:2004
# Colors for teams (typically derived from jersey's first colors)
Colors =
id:Canada            value:rgb(0.85, 0.12, 0.02)
id:Finland           value:rgb(0,    0.61, 0.77)
id:Russia            value:rgb(0.64, 0.11, 0.14)
id:Sweden            value:rgb(0.97, 0.85, 0.02)
id:USA    value:rgb(0.07, 0.20, 0.40)
LineData =
# A line at the right side of the graph
from:30/09/2003 till:end atpos:65 color:black width:0.5
# Setup text and color to use in the labeled bars
Define $labelCanada = text:"Canada" color:Canada
Define $labelFinland = text:"Finland" color:Finland
Define $labelRussia = text:"Russia" color:Russia
Define $labelSweden = text:"Sweden" color:Sweden
Define $labelUSA = text:"United States" color:USA
PlotData =
bar:Leaders width:25 mark:(line,black)
from:29/09/2003 till:27/02/2006 shift:(20,-5) $labelCanada
from:27/02/2006 till:19/05/2008 shift:(20,-5) $labelSweden
from:19/05/2008 till:11/05/2009 shift:(20,-5) $labelCanada
from:11/05/2009 till:01/03/2010 shift:(20,-5) $labelRussia
from:01/03/2010 till:24/05/2010 shift:(20,-5) $labelCanada
from:24/05/2010 till:20/05/2013 shift:(20,-5) $labelRussia
from:20/05/2013 till:18/05/2015 shift:(20,-5) $labelSweden
from:18/05/2015 till:21/02/2022 shift:(20,-5) $labelCanada
from:21/02/2022 till:29/05/2023 shift:(20,-5) $labelFinland
from:29/05/2023 till:26/05/2025 shift:(20,-5) $labelCanada
from:26/05/2025 till:end shift:(20,-5) $labelUSA
:Category:Ice hockey templates
}}
